column1: # Evaluation sentences for a Belarusian voice. Tab separated: id, group, text, audio (optional human recording).
# The groups are the places a Belarusian voice actually breaks: stress (not written, and it changes the word),
# ў, dzekanne/cekanne, long consonants, voicing assimilation, numbers, abbreviations, computing terms, names.
# These 25 are written for this test and carry no third-party licence. Rows with a human recording are added from
# FLEURS be_by (CC-BY-4.0) by eval/add_fleurs.py, so the same sentences have a human ceiling.
# `reference`, when given, is the spoken form the voice should produce; it is what gets scored. For formulas it
# is one accepted reading, so a different correct reading still counts as an error there — read those rows by ear.
